claim: Patchline ships a heterogeneity-of-treatment-effects analysis identifying who benefits most. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the heterogeneity claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make hte-analysis-gate`.
